description: Strong winds collapsed war-torn buildings over makeshift camps in Gaza, killing at least 8 Palestinians this week, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. description:
President Donald Trump warned he might invoke the centuries-old Insurrection Act to deploy US troops to Minnesota as state and federal officials clash over tactics used by immigration agents.

CNN's Alayna Treene reports from the White House, CNN senior law enforcement analyst and former Deputy FBI Director Andrew McCabe weighs in, and CNN's Sara Sidner speaks with Robin Wonsley, a Democratic socialist who sits on the Minneapolis City Council.

0:36 "This is a very big deal": CNN White House reporter on threat

8:19 Minneapolis City Council member on threat
#Minnesota #InsurrectionAct #News
